notesForTechWriter: shared/schemas/pipeline/implementation.schema.json and qa.schema.json each gained an optional filesDeleted/testFilesDeleted array, generated from the Go structs and verified green by TestCommittedSchemasMatchTheStructs; worth a line in any pipeline-contract docs covering the implementation-notes.md / qa-report.md field lists.

A rename is always two fields now: the new path in filesCreated/testFilesCreated, the old path in filesDeleted/testFilesDeleted. An 'old -> new' entry in any single path-naming field (including security's filesModified) fails validation before any claim is checked.
